description: A vaulted underground chamber with a shaft of light falling diagonally from an opening at upper left, showing a stepped ramp. In the centre foreground a gold bull's head with blue beard and horns sits on a carved wooden bier draped in brown cloth. Beside it a golden lyre with an inlaid panel stands at the front. A headless bust wearing a gold leaf headdress and layered red, blue and beaded necklaces rests on the right of the bier. Gold and silver cups, a bowl, daggers and a jar lie on the stone floor. Dim figures slumped or lying in the shadowed side areas.
